entries.title: Hebrews 4:1
segments: Therefore, a promise being left to enter into His rest, let us fear lest any of you should seem to come short of it.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:2
segments: For also the gospel was preached [to us], as well as to them. But the word [preached] did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in those who heard [it].

entries.title: Hebrews 4:3
segments: For we who have believed do enter into the rest, as He said, "I have sworn in My wrath that they should not enter into My rest;" although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:4
segments: For He spoke in a certain place of the seventh [day] in this way: "And God rested the seventh day from all His works."

entries.title: Hebrews 4:5
segments: And in this place again, "They shall not enter into My rest."

entries.title: Hebrews 4:6
segments: Since then it remains that some must enter into it, and since they to whom it was first preached did not enter in because of unbelief,

entries.title: Hebrews 4:7
segments: He again marks out a certain day, saying in David, "Today," (after so long a time). Even as it is said, "Today, if you will hear His voice, harden not your hearts."

entries.title: Hebrews 4:8
segments: For if Joshua had given them rest, then He would not afterward have spoken of another day.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:9
segments: So then there remains a rest to the people of God.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:10
segments: For he who has entered into his rest, he also has ceased from his own works, as God [did] from His.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:11
segments: Therefore let us labor to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of unbelief.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:12
segments: For the word of God [is] living and powerful and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to [the] dividing apart of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:13
segments: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in His sight, but all things [are] naked and opened to the eyes of Him with whom we have to do.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:14
segments: Since then we have a great High Priest who has passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast [our] profession.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:15
segments: For we do not have a high priest who cannot be touched with the feelings of our infirmities, but was in all points tempted just as [we are, yet] without sin.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:16
segments: Therefore let us come boldly to the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need.
